rules.message: a data-hc-sortable container needs at least one [data-hc-sortable-handle] — the handle is both the pointer target and the keyboard interface.
handles should be real <button type="button"> elements — anything else is not focusable, so keyboard users cannot reorder. (warn: a focusable custom element may be intentional)
a container that posts the order needs data-hx-trigger="hc:sortchange" — without it htmx never fires the persistence request. (warn: the trigger may live on a wrapping form instead)

persisting the order needs a per-item control whose ORDER is what serializes — a hidden input per item (name="order[]"), or a named control per item like the sort control's dir-<key> selects. (warn: apps reading the hc:sortchange event detail instead may omit them)
